key_insight: This review maps bias in AI disease detection and highlights data diversity, explainability, and fairness-aware design as priorities for more equitable systems.
clinical_relevance: Recognizing bias in diagnostic AI may help clinicians and health systems evaluate whether tools perform equitably across patient populations.
method: Reviewed disease-detection AI studies within a stated 2015–2026 window.
Organized approaches by input data, model architecture, and bias type.
Examined identification and mitigation of algorithmic, demographic, model, and deployment bias.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 23 included articles from 64,389 records analyzed across seven digital libraries, without quantitative fairness or diagnostic-performance results.
watch_item: The review identifies research priorities but does not establish that any mitigation strategy reliably improves fairness in clinical deployment.
paper_title: Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection
